items.quote: One of the biggest mistakes the beginners make is, wait for it, being too polite.
items.statement: Beginners in real estate often make the mistake of being too polite.

items.quote: But guess what? In real estate, being too nice can cost you a big time.
items.statement: Being too nice in real estate can be detrimental to success.

items.quote: You have to dig deep and find out what the client's actual situation is and what problems they are trying to solve with the real estate.
items.statement: It is crucial to understand the client's actual situation and problems they're trying to solve.

items.quote: When you're walking into the doctor's appointment and there is a nice doctor in a, you know, full gear medical person, how will you yourself determine if he is a professional or someone who is just graduated from the medical school?
items.statement: How one discerns professionalism in a doctor can be analogous to recognizing credibility in real estate agents.

items.quote: If the person starts to jump up and down, I'm the best doctor and I can absolutely cure you. Will you actually believe him?
items.statement: Clients are less likely to believe an overly boastful sales pitch compared to one that provokes deeper reflection on their needs.

items.quote: the doctor who is asking you questions sometimes might be not very polite, he helping you realize that the problem is way bigger than you expected.
items.statement: A doctor who asks probing questions, even if less polite, helps patients recognize underlying issues.

overview: A transcript from a YouTube short discussing common mistakes made by beginners in real estate sales.
